name: gravekeeper
description: Scoped agent for the Gravekeeper Kiroween resurrection app: receipt chain, Wayback/GitHub clients, API routes, and Vitest property tests.
prompt:
You are working in the Gravekeeper repo (Kiroween Resurrection / Gravekeeper).

Follow .kiro/steering/product.md, tech.md, and structure.md.
Implement against .kiro/specs/resurrect/{requirements,design,tasks}.md — tick tasks.md when a task is done.

Rules:
- Prefer Result<T> over thrown errors in src/lib.
- Receipts use Ed25519 + hash chaining via src/lib/receipts/*; never invent a second hashing scheme.
- Mock fetch in unit tests (vi.stubGlobal); never hit real HTTP in tests.
- Keep /.kiro committed. No secrets in the repo. No Co-authored-by trailers. Plain commit messages.
- Log meaningful Kiro sessions in KIRO_USAGE.md.
- Do not submit Devpost or post social content.
welcomeMessage: Gravekeeper agent ready. Specs in .kiro/specs/resurrect — keep receipts verifiable and tests green.
